subject.title: fix(macos): skip unresolved dashboard auth templates

question: Should this PR wait for redacted real macOS Finder/Dock plus LaunchAgent proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate based on source review and CI?
rationale: The code path and tests look correct, but this external PR still has not shown the blocked native macOS user flow in a real setup, and ClawSweeper cannot safely substitute that proof.

options.title: Require native app proof
options.body: Hold merge until the contributor adds redacted macOS app proof, dashboard URL or log output, or equivalent live output showing LaunchAgent fallback and no placeholder fragment.

options.title: Override with CI-only evidence
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the Swift tests and CI as enough, owning the risk of merging without observed Finder/Dock recovery proof.

options.title: Pause for an alternate candidate
options.body: If native app ownership prefers another linked PR or a broader gateway-resolved URL design, keep this branch open but do not land it as the canonical fix yet.

recommendation.title: Require native app proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until the contributor adds redacted macOS app proof, dashboard URL or log output, or equivalent live output showing LaunchAgent fallback and no placeholder fragment.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof and merge-readiness question sits in the native macOS dashboard/gateway endpoint surface where steipete has the strongest recent history.
